recipes.oracle_text:
Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Cipher (Then you may exile this spell card encoded on a creature you control. Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player, its controller may cast a copy of the encoded card without paying its mana cost.)

recipe_coverage: Oracle-reviewed single-card recovery: eligible alternatives and full-zone indices, type/color/value restrictions, graveyard ownership, exact/insufficient mana, empty zone, ordered unaffected zones, target departure and index shift through a real Reclaim response, populated-zone snapshot replay. Reanimation also checks entry characteristics and subsequent death ownership; subtype bonuses are explicit. Multi-target recovery, graveyard shroud, replacement effects, and exceptional card types remain separate. This declaration tests the normal hand-cast recovery component; Cipher encoding and combat copies remains separate.
